ideas.pitch: A Python-based simulation utility and controller engine that maps unseen battlefields, calculates optimal A* routing around hidden hazards, and dynamically optimizes resource gathering for turn-based rover strategy games.
ideas.problem_statement: Develop autonomous rover controllers to explore unfamiliar terrain, gather resources, defend territory, and outmanoeuvre rival teams in a turn-based strategy game.
ideas.title: A* Pathfinding and Hazard-Avoidance Visualizer for Rover Fleet
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the core algorithmic bottleneck of the competition with robust pathfinding and decision trees, matching the winning pattern of genuinely hard engineering.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent decision-making agent built using Minimax search with Alpha-Beta pruning to evaluate tactical combat tradeoffs, enemy vault raids, and resource-driven upgrades under uncertainty.
ideas.problem_statement: Program your rovers to explore the map, mine resources, raid enemy vaults, engage in combat, and manage upgrades to maximise their score.
ideas.title: Minimax-AlphaBeta Rover Combat Controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Outsmarts heuristic-based rivals in head-to-head turn-based matches by anticipating opponent moves several turns ahead, leveraging algorithmic superiority for live dominance.

ideas.pitch: A real-time monitoring dashboard that hooks into the rover simulation backend to display fleet health, resource accumulation rates, predictive territory defense scores, and match win-probability analytics.
ideas.problem_statement: Design intelligent controllers to explore unfamiliar terrain, gather resources, defend their territory, and outmanoeuvre rival teams.
ideas.title: RoverTelemetry Live Ops Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in live offline finals love a visually compelling tactical command center that makes autonomous decisions transparent and easy to demonstrate.

ideas.pitch: An Arduino-based physical control pad allowing manual override and tactical targeting inputs during the live finals exhibition, integrating hardware controls with autonomous algorithms.
ideas.problem_statement: On-site interactive competition conducted at IIT Madras featuring a free-for-all format where participants program rovers to explore, mine, and engage in combat.
ideas.title: Hardware-In-The-Loop Joystick Controller for Rover Targeting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly channels the physical build pattern from previous winners, making an immediate unforgettable impression in an offline room dominated by software-only entries.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight Q-learning agent designed to adapt rover upgrade strategies on the fly when unexpected dynamic in-game events alter the balance of the battlefield.
ideas.problem_statement: Manage upgrades to maximise their score while adapting to dynamic in-game events and hidden hazards that shift the balance of the game.
ideas.title: Reinforcement Learning State-Action Optimizer for Dynamic In-Game Events
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts autonomously to unpredictable game mechanics introduced in the finals stage, showcasing advanced machine learning application under uncertainty.
